notes: Primary source: Digital Projection's official "Titan Laser WUXGA" Installation & Operating Guide (Rev A, Jan 2019), which covers the 29000 WU / 33000 WU / 37000 WU family sharing one connections panel, cross-checked against ProjectorCentral's spec page and Digital Projection's product/spec-sheet pages (springtree.net, avfranklin.com mirrors of DP's official PDF). Confirmed from the manual: 4x HDMI (1/2 = HDMI 2.0 HDCP2.2, 3/4 = HDMI 1.4b HDCP1.4 for 3D), DisplayPort 1.2, HDBaseT/LAN (RJ45), dual 3G-SDI (75-ohm BNC, in+loop-through out), Ethernet/Art-Net (RJ45), RS-232 (DB9), Wired Remote (3.5mm TRS), 3D Sync In/Out, 3D Sync IR, and two 12V Trigger outputs. Power: ProjectorCentral and independent listings state 200-240VAC 50/60Hz, ~17A, 3400W; the manual describes a locking mains connector (push in, rotate 90 degrees to lock, different cable variants for USA vs Rest-of-World) but does not name the exact IEC pin configuration, so iec-c19 was chosen as the closest listed high-current locking-IEC match — treat this port's connector id as an approximation. Sync In/Out and Trigger 1/2 physical connector types (BNC vs mini-jack) are inferred from typical Digital Projection Titan-series hardware and industry convention; the extracted manual text does not explicitly state their connector type (only pin diagrams for HDMI, RS232, and IR/wired-remote were given), so these are flagged as inferred. No lens is included (sold separately); the unit is a large floor/rigged installation projector, not rack-mountable, hence rackUnits omitted. Weight ~209 lb (95 kg), dimensions ~38.2 x 25.6 x 15.6 in per ProjectorCentral/manufacturer. IP60-rated sealed optical engine, liquid-cooled/filterless.
